terms.definition: An assessment of the environmental impact of a product at each stage: extracting and processing raw materials, manufacturing and packaging, use, and disposal.
terms.examiner: Some values (pollutant effects) are hard to measure, so judgements are needed.

terms.definition: Reducing use of materials saves raw materials, energy and waste.
terms.examiner: Recycling metals uses less energy than extraction.

terms.definition: Glass bottles can be reused; other glass is crushed and melted to make new products.
Metals are melted and recast or reformed into different products.
terms.examiner: Sorting and separation can be expensive.
